title: create_channel input
description: Create a channel before anything posts to it (a first post also creates one). private: true closes it to everyone but you with two grants; it needs manage there and fails if the channel, a channel under it, or a grant for it already exists.

path.description: Channel path such as dev or www/production (lowercase segments of letters, digits, '-' and '_' joined by '/', up to 6 segments of 40 characters)
